about.title: About Me
about.summary: I am Albert, a Backend, DevOps & Agentic AI Engineer with experience in designing and implementing scalable architectures. Specialized in Java, Go, and Node.js with a strong focus on cloud-native solutions, CI/CD, and automation.
about.summary2: Passionate about building robust and scalable systems. I enjoy solving complex problems and working with modern technologies to deliver high-quality solutions.
about.backend: Backend Development with Java, Go & Node.js

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: Over the past years, I have been working on designing and developing scalable backend systems, implementing microservices architectures, and automating infrastructure. My roles have focused on building robust APIs, managing cloud environments, and improving development workflows through CI/CD practices. I actively integrate Agentic AI tools into my workflow to accelerate development, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality.

oysho.name: Oysho
oysho.description: Internal backoffice for Oysho: migration of legacy systems to Java 25, Spring Boot 4, and React 19 with clean code, Kafka, and Agentic AI.
tasks: Led internal migration of legacy systems to Java 25, Spring Boot 4, and React 19.
Applied clean code principles and hexagonal architecture to improve maintainability.
Integrated Agentic AI capabilities to automate workflows.

codebench.name: Codebench
codebench.description: Scalable system for automatic code validation in educational environments.
tasks: Designed and developed a scalable system to automatically validate code submissions, reducing manual correction time.
Built backend microservices using Java Spring Boot with asynchronous communication via RabbitMQ.
Orchestration of containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Integrated CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and automated infrastructure on AWS.

feeder-health.name: Feeder Health
feeder-health.description: Platform for healthcare professionals to track patient metrics via a Chrome extension and video consultations, with an interactive dashboard for facial micro-expression analysis.
tasks: Developed a Chrome extension to capture patient micro-expressions during video consultations.
Built a NestJS backend with RabbitMQ for async processing of facial analysis data.
Implemented real-time dashboards using WebSockets and Socket.io for live patient evolution tracking.
Deployed on AWS with CI/CD pipelines via Bitbucket.

feeder-metrics.name: Feeder Metrics
feeder-metrics.description: Platform for marketing audiences to validate advertising spots through facial micro-expression analysis.
tasks: Developed and maintained REST APIs in a microservices architecture using Spring Boot and NestJS communicated with RabbitMQ.
Migration from monolith to microservices, applying Hexagonal Architecture and DDD.
Designed and managed relational and non-relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
Implemented CI/CD pipelines and deployed cloud infrastructure on AWS.

foxize-cloud.name: Foxize Cloud
foxize-cloud.description: SaaS e-learning platform for online course creation and management.
tasks: Developed and maintained a SaaS e-learning platform using Symfony (PHP).
Applied SOLID principles and improved code maintainability.
Development of frontend functionalities with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with Twig templates.
